quote:
A single spark in the sea of agreements can ignite either the warmth of peace or the tempest of war.  

When a nation throws a stone into the well of its own reputation, the ripple speaks louder than the silence of its people.  

When a land is haunted by unseen bats, the people learn that the hush of caution may be swifter than a warning gong.  

The drumbeats of the many echo louder than a ruler's decree, yet the echo may silence only those who learn to hear against the tide.  

Closer than a stone, a private gathering holds sway over a nation's fate, for quiet words spun in dim rooms ripple across oceans.  

When history is rewritten by a blank pen, the truth slumbers until the wind of conscience bares what remains hidden.  

A child born of miracle's seed finds a companion in the sky, proving that patience, like water, shapes even stone into blossoms.
